points.description: States that one of the quantities is rainfall intensity (rainfall rate / depth of rain per unit time).
points.partial_credit: Half if says just 'rainfall' or 'rainfall depth' without intensity.

points.description: States that the other quantity is time.

rubric.notes: Full marks if the student gives rainfall intensity and time, in either order and in any wording. Give part marks if only one is correct, or if 'rainfall' or 'rainfall depth' is given in place of intensity. Give no marks for unrelated answers such as discharge or stage.
